title: VQ Mirror address codebook
hypothesis: For key addresses on a known continuous 2D rotation orbit, shared basis plus one continuous Mirror angle per key will preserve exact/paraphrase retrieval at lower total serialized bytes than full key vectors and fixed-size VQ codebooks; collision rate and address-density failure must be measured as logical address count grows.
physical_object: one shared D=32 key plane; explicit per-key radii and values remain paid
mirror_coordinate: one continuous key angle per logical address
controls: full explicit GRACE-style key vectors with fixed radius and explicit output values
generic Cartesian coefficients over the same shared key plane
uniform VQ address codebooks K=8/16/32/64/128 with per-key indices

task.type: synthetic 32D address bank with 4D explicit values
task.key_orbit: unit vectors at near-uniform angles on a known 2D plane with small deterministic jitter
task.query: exact address; four Gaussian paraphrases sigma .01 per address; 512 unrelated random queries
task.scope: cosine threshold .95, identical for all methods
metrics: false trigger rate and output error
actual total payload bytes and bytes/address
address decode MAC and bank/query latency

development.allowed: fixed deterministic address construction and predeclared VQ K sweep; no fresh-dependent parameter changes

paid_objects: full key vectors or shared key basis plus Mirror/Cartesian codes or full VQ codebook and indices

success_gate: Every fresh world at N64: Mirror exact/paraphrase correct-address recall>=99%, false triggers<=1%, output NRMSE<=1e-5, payload<=70% full explicit address bank; compare with generic coefficients and VQ Pareto. At N128 report crowding even if the gate fails.
failure_gate: Mirror fails N64 retrieval/quality/byte gates or simpler address control matches/beats it at equal recall; also report collision-driven capacity boundary.
boundaries: Synthetic address-code mechanism, not GRACE/VQ-VAE reproduction.
Continuous orbit and basis are hand known; no learned address encoder.
Output values remain explicit and identical across address methods to isolate address compression.
